name: [Ψ]Heightened Senses (C)
description:
All of your senses are heightened, allowing you to see further and hear better, and at higher levels even see in murky water or use minor vibrations and small sounds to determine moving creatures nearby.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 5 leads to Aura Sight.
Level 8 leads to Night Eyes.
Level 6 leads to Premonition.
Level 3 leads to See Mechanisms.

name: [Ψ]Speed Reader (C)
description:
Your powers make words fairly leap off the page directly into your mind, allowing you to read much faster and better absorb what you read.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

Level 8 leads to Intuitive Artisan with Premonition 6.
Level 8 leads to Psychometry with Aura Sight 6 OR Speed Reader 8 OR Premonition 8.

name: [Ψ]Premonition (C)
description:
You can sense nearby movement and sometimes gain an advance warning of dangerous events.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 6 leads to Clairvoyance.
Level 10 leads to Combat Sense with Clairvoyance 6.
Level 6 leads to Intuitive Artisan with Speed Reader 8.
Level 8 leads to Psychometry with Aura Sight 6 OR Speed Reader 8 OR Premonition 8.

name: [Ψ]Night Eyes (C)
description:
You are able to sense your surroundings in areas of low light, and you can even "see" in pitch darkness.  Strictly speaking, this is not vision, and you cannot discern fine details or read.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 10 leads to Clarity.

name: [Ψ]Aura Sight (C)
description:
You can see people's emotions and physical state as a hazy swirl of color around their body.  This makes it much easier to get them to do what you want.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

Level 6 leads to Psychometry with Aura Sight 6 OR Speed Reader 8 OR Premonition 8.

name: [Ψ]Radiation Sense
description: You can open your tenses to the tell-tale glow of radiation.

description.str: Sense your personal radiation.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
Sense your environmental radiation.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
This is the reoccurring item summon for Radiation Sense.  It's a bug if you have it.

name: [Ψ]Marksman's Eye (C)
description:
With your enhanced senses, you can increase the effective range and accuracy of your ranged attacks.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 9 leads to One Perfect Shot.
Level 7 leads to Prescient Tactician with Clarity 5 + Combat Sense 8.

name: [Ψ]Psychometry
description: You can examine an item and use your enhanced senses to determine its properties that may not be obvious to the eye.

name: [Ψ]Clairvoyance
description:
The classic example of a clairsentient's powers, you can see through walls and reveal everything nearby.

Level 6 leads to Combat Sense with Premonition 10.
Level 14 leads to Omniscence with Clarity 5 + Satellite View 8 OR Clairvoyance 14 + Clarity 5.
Level 8 leads to Satellite View.

name: [Ψ]Combat Sense (C)
description:
By gazing just a few moments into the future, you can be wherever your enemies are not attacking.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 8 leads to Prescient Tactician with Clarity 5 + Marksman's Eye 7.

name: [Ψ]Intuitive Artisan (C)
description:
Opening yourself up to the immediate future, you can see the best option to take when crafting or working on a task.  However, due to the intensity of the visions you will be <color_red>blind</color> to the outside world while crafting anything.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

name: [Ψ]One Perfect Shot
description: Gaze into the future and, taking your enemy's future movements into account, fire at the perfect moment.  This power will only last for a single attack.
message: It's time to take the shot.

name: [Ψ]Satellite View
description:
You can extend your senses over the landscape, becoming aware of every hill, building, and valley within a large area.

Level 8 leads to Omniscence with Clarity 5 + Satellite View 8 OR Clairvoyance 14 + Clarity 5.
message: You close your eyes and concentrate, and you can see the landscape spread out as though you were a bird on the wing.

//: GENERATED spellcasting_finish caster-tag for clair_see_map (Nether Attunement / power-cost event bridge; see mom_hooks.lua).

description.str: Hidden nether-attunement cast tag.  It's a bug if you can cast it directly.

name: [Ψ]Clarity (C)
description:
Thanks to your powers, nothing can stop you from seeing the world as it is.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

Level 5 leads to Omniscence with Clarity 5 + Satellite View 8 OR Clairvoyance 14 + Clarity 5.
Level 5 leads to Prescient Tactician with Combat Sense 8 + Marksman's Eye 7.

name: [Ψ]Prescient Tactician (C)
description:
Gazing into the near future, you can call out warnings to your followers so they can avoid attacks before they occur.  This will greatly increase their defensive capability, though it will be harder for you to defend yourself.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

name: [Ψ]Omniscence
description: Extend your senses to a supernal degree, perceiving everything within the nearby area.  Every creature, every object, every blade of grass, everything.  <color_red>EVERYTHING</color>.

//: GENERATED spellcasting_finish caster-tag for clair_omniscience (Nether Attunement / power-cost event bridge; see mom_hooks.lua).
